name: Hating Your Enemy
overview: Scripture clearly commands believers to reject hatred and vengeance toward others, emphasizing instead love even for those considered enemies. Leviticus 19:18 instructs not to bear grudges but to love one's neighbor as oneself, while Jesus, in Matthew 5, challenges the traditional notion of hating enemies by teaching His followers to love, bless, do good to, and pray for those who oppose or persecute them. This radical call reveals the heart of Christ-centered love that transcends natural inclinations and reflects God’s character.
